subject: CATH
title: Introduction to Catholicism
description: This course offers an exploration of the Roman Catholic tradition in its intellectual, religious, moral, and cultural dimensions. It provides an interdisciplinary study of the ways in which Catholicism has shaped Western civilization.

subject: CATH
title: Selected Topics in Catholic Studies
description: A review of selected topics in Catholic studies.

subject: CATH
title: Catholic Intellectual Traditions
description: This course examines Catholic intellectual perspectives, schools of thought, and major thinkers, with focus on topics such as God, faith and reason, the human person, history, culture and community. Will also examine the interaction between Catholicism and other perspectives and traditions.

prerequisites.text: CATH 200, RELG 320, or permission of instructor

subject: CATH
title: Catholicism and Modernity
description: An exploration of major historical developments in modern Catholicism. The course will examine broad historical trends as well as regional contexts.

subject: CATH
title: Mystery and the Imagination
description: An exploration of Catholic perspectives on faith, reason, meaning and mystery through literature, art, music, and film.

restrictions.text: Not open to those who have taken 190-370A in 2001-02 or CATH 370 in 2002-03.

subject: CATH
title: Catholicism in a Global Context
description: An exploration of Catholicism as a global phenomenon through case studies of its multiple expressions in Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Americas. Topics include transnational Catholic movements and interreligious engagement.

subject: CATH
title: Confessions of Saint Augustine
description: A close reading of Augustine's monumental Confessions- the odyssey of a restless soul seeking rest in God alone (conf. 1.1.)

subject: CATH
title: Catholicism and Public Policy
description: An examination of Catholic social thought, including intellectual and institutional engagement with a wide range of key public policy issues in spheres such as politics, law, economics, diplomacy, and international development.

subject: CATH
title: Topics in Catholic Studies
description: A review of selected topics in Catholica studies. Topics vary by year.

subject: CATH
title: Indigenous Religiosity and Spirituality
description: A review of selected topics in Catholica studies. Topics vary by year.

subject: CATH
title: Topics in Catholic Theology
description: A review of selected topics in Catholic Theology.

subject: CATH
title: Topics in Catholic Theology
description: A review of selected topics in Catholic Theology.

subject: CATH
title: Catholic Studies Seminar
description: A research seminar on a major theme and/or thinker. The seminar will evolve around primary source materials.
